messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert -> high-severity: Smart routing fallback amplification detected (us-east). Incident ID INC-1970023456. Trigger: 5xx surge + malformed token streams.
sam_oncall: acked. Looking at topology and routing rules. spiking errors around 2026-03-15T02:10:xxZ
maya_sre: quick summary from dashboards: 4.8% error rate for /v1/chat.generate, latency tail jumping 600ms -> 2.1s, retries up x3. Observed repeated cross-region fallbacks: us-east -> us-central -> us-east.
leo_runtime: initial hypothesis: cache key namespace doesn't encode variant/quant flag, so a request routed to redwood-2.7b-quant can pick up a KV stream generated by redwood-2.7b (non-quant), causing token sequence mismatch -> runtime fails to apply tokens and triggers fallback. That then re-routes and can re-trigger similar mismatches causing loop and retries.
tara_support: customer impact: 18 customer tickets in last 45m. Two enterprise customers are affected: AeroPay (payment flows) and GreenAtlas (search summaries). AeroPay reported truncated/incoherent tokens causing failed confirmations.
maya_sre: supporting evidence from runtime logs (snip):
```
[2026-03-15T02:12:07Z] route req_id=abc123 model=redwood-2.7b-quant region=us-east policy=cost_aware -> chosen_node=node-22 shard=kv-shard-3
[2026-03-15T02:12:07Z] kv.get key=redwood-2.7b:us-east:prefix=0x9f1 -> HIT ver=128 source=node-21
[2026-03-15T02:12:07Z] apply_kv req=abc123 variant=redwood-2.7b-quant -> kv_stream=non-quant-tokenized -> token-apply-failure -> fallback to us-central
```
leo_runtime: locating offending code: cache_key_builder located at runtime/cache/keying.py. Current logic builds keys from model.base_name and region only. Patch ready that will include variant and quant flag.
maya_sre: thanks. We should aim for short mitigation first: 1) flip routing policy to disable cross-region fallback to preserve consistency 2) push hotfix to canary 3) purge suspect KV entries from affected shards 4) monitor golden prompt set and customer slow path.
sam_oncall: initiating step 1 now (disable cross-region fallback for redwood-2.7b* in us-east).
deploy-bot: config-change: routing/us-east/cross_region_fallback - disabled for model_prefix=redwood-2.7b by sam_oncall at 2026-03-15T02:18:10Z :white_check_mark:
sam_oncall: config flip done. Watching metrics, note: fallback rate dropping but latency still elevated due to retries queued.
leo_runtime: hotfix diff (proposed):
```diff
- def build_cache_key(model, region, prefix_hash):
-     return f"{model.base_name}:{region}:{prefix_hash}"
+ def build_cache_key(model, region, prefix_hash):
+     # include variant and quantization flag to prevent cross-variant key collisions
+     quant_flag = 'q' if getattr(model, 'quantized', False) else 'nq'
+     return f"{model.base_name}:{model.variant}:{quant_flag}:{region}:{prefix_hash}"
```
leo_runtime: opening PR: https://git.example/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/512 - CI passed locally. Preparing canary push to us-east-canary group.
maya_sre: step 3: KV purge plan: targeted delete on kv-shard-3 + kv-shard-4 for keys matching regex `^redwood-2.7b(:|$)` - run with rate limit 200 ops/s and tombstone delay 30s to avoid transient misses. I'll run purge after canary success.
tara_support: updated company notes to affected accounts: AeroPay & GreenAtlas assigned SE contacts. We placed mitigation note and asked for repro examples.
leo_runtime: canary deploy started
deploy-bot: deploy-start: runtime/cache-hotfix-canary-1970023456 by leo_runtime
leo_runtime: canary steady for 6m. Running golden prompts and larger synthetic replay. Observed cache-hit semantics now include variant tag, no cross-variant hits on canary nodes.
maya_sre: metrics after config flip + canary: error-rate dropped 4.8% -> 0.9%, 95p latency down 40%. Good sign. Proceed with KV purge on shards now.
leo_runtime: executing purge script: ```
-- purge keys matching legacy prefix
DELETE FROM kv_store WHERE key LIKE 'redwood-2.7b:%' AND shard IN (3,4) LIMIT 42000;
-- throttle at 200r/s, tombstone=30s
```
deploy-bot: purge-run: kv-purge/1970023456 by maya_sre - removed 42,318 keys across shards
leo_runtime: rolling hotfix to us-east-prod now
deploy-bot: deploy-complete: runtime/cache-hotfix-1970023456 - completed in 00:09:04
maya_sre: post-deploy verification: ran 1000 golden prompts, 998 passed exact-match heuristics, token-shape anomalies resolved. Customer reports stabilizing; AeroPay confirms reduced failures.
sam_oncall: preparing handoff. Current status: routing fallback disabled, hotfix deployed prod, purge done, customer outreach in progress, monitoring shows stable behavior. Leaving pager pinned and escalation channel open.
ops-pager: create incident report and schedule 60m postmortem with owners (maya_sre, leo_runtime, sam_oncall). Please include timeline, blast radius, and mitigation choreography.
nina_product: I'll coordinate customer comms and share postmortem summary with Sales/Account teams after SRE draft is ready.
maya_sre: next steps assigned in tracker: (1) make variant+quant canonical cache key in all runtimes, (2) add unit + integration tests ensuring no cache-hit across different variant flags, (3) simulate fallback amplification in chaos tests, (4) add alert detecting repeated cross-region KV hits for same request id. I'll own postmortem.
sam_oncall: handoff to maya_sre. Leaving detailed notes in incident tracker and linking PRs + purge logs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
